title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
script:
Replit is officially ending its work with Anthropic. CEO Amjad Masad confirmed the decision this week.
Masad cited multiple reasons for the split, including high costs.
Replit previously signed a major partnership with OpenAI back in August.
Users had no prior warning that the Anthropic deal was ending.
This move marks a shift in how Replit manages its internal model integrations.
TechCrunch reported the development after Masad addressed the change.
Will OpenAI now become the primary provider for all Replit services?
